projects.title: SuperSort
projects.goal: Search for genuinely new, architecture-aware mechanisms that make practically relevant sorting tasks substantially faster than the best existing implementations.

latest.title: Producing two batches and their merged view on Linux
latest.summary: Adjusted page placement was 1.231–1.280× as fast as the best direct writer across eight fresh edge-overlap cases on two Linux runners. Every case missed the 1.30× target, and building the two batches took 80–84% of the remapping time.
latest.result: 1.231–1.280× on the eight holdout cases, with 0/8 meeting the 77% time limit
